theorems.name: Submission.iwl_cr_cest_mass_le_of_forms
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k) (c R : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → 0 ≤ R → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k univ, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, C ω = X ψ ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ c * (R + δ)) → C.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * R) * X.mass
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
